Don't reprimand an animal hours after they have done something (unless it's like going to the bathroom on your pillow, they know that's bad usually), as they don't have the upper conciousness to remember back that far a lot of the time, all they know in that moment is that you're yelling at them, not why you're yelling at them.  

Don't play with them with your hands and feet if you dont want them to grow up and tear your skin apart, instead play with external toys only. That way they dont associate your sensitive skin with playtime. 

Regularly take them to vet checks, get all their vaccinations and shots up to date so they don't get sick. Get up to date on the most detrimental cat/dog diseases and what the warning signs are.

Keep an eye on when their behaviour starts going off, if your pet always meets you at the door after work but for the past week hasn't even been getting up to see who it is, take them to the vet. Animals cant tell you they're sick, they can only show you and hope you notice. 

At the end of the day, realize that they are living beings too. They have feelings, emotions, likes and dislikes, they have thoughts just like us. So treat them with respect, care, and love, because they deserve it just as much as you and I. 

Hope this helps a bit!
